verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own RTX 5090 page publishes capacity and memory type (32 GB GDDR7). The 512-bit bus width appears only in a Tom's Hardware review, not in first-party docs, and no source in the pack gives memory bandwidth, so the specs are not published in full. Missing for 10: first-party bus-width spec, memory bandwidth figure (GB/s), a full official spec sheet for the exact part.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, memory specs are published in full for this exact part — capacity, memory type, bus width, and bandwidth

citations.quote: The GeForce RTX 5090 is powered by the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture and equipped with 32 GB of super-fast GDDR7 memory
